body.p: Long ago there lived two men and their families. One man was older than his friend, he had many children. And his neighbour had a child [in a] cradle. Once the men went hunting. Their families stayed in the tent. The older woman and her children made noise for the whole night. Her neighbour got angry: "Why do you let you children make noise? People may come". On the third day an old woman came in. Having entered the tent, she sat down at the entrance. Having sat down she started to look constantly at [one] neighbour. The younger woman wrapped her child, until that one stopped looking. Having wrapped her child the woman said: "Well, granny, take your [DCh]: Not sure whether "ka-" is indeed a variant of "ga-"; however, leg aside". The old woman made room for the woman. Having dressed there is no entry for "ka-" in dictionaries.her skies she went along the trace of their relatives. Behind her shouts were heard(?). At some place the woman [DCh]: Not entirely sure about "seÅa-".caught up her relatives. Her husband said: "Why do you [come] here?" The woman said: "Some devil came to our tent. Then I ran off. Behind me shouts were heard". The men returned to their tents. Having come they went in. In their tent their is nobody. The man started to speculate: "Where are my relatives gone?" His friend said: "Well, man! Look at the trace [which leads] out of the tent". His friend had a look and didn't see any trace. He said: "I see the trace of a mouse". The other one said: "Well, man! Go along the trace you've seen". He went off along the trace. It turned into the sled of an ermine. He started to follow the trace again. The trace of the ermine led through a hole. He also creeped through where [the ermine] had creeped through. Inside the hole he found the old woman. Having gone in he said: "Well, Granny, let me go for wood". Having finished cutting wood, he brought it in. The old woman doesn't say anything. The man pierced the old woman with a spear. Having killed the old woman he went home. When he came, his friend asked: "Well, what's on, did you find [anything] or not?" His friend said: "I found an old woman lying in the tent. She didn't say anything to me. I killed her". Then the men wandered off from their tents forever. Those people are probably wandering until today.
